snippet.title: My Eerie Lair Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.
Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621690/My_Eerie_Lair/
